text:
emma (People Ops): leaving this thread open for follow-ups from today's all-hands about travel, hubs, offsites, and the new hybrid pilots. Keep Qs short and we'll answer here. :wave:

raj (Eng): quick one 1: for team offsites, is the new per-person cap applied before or after tax/fees? planning budget.
molly (PM): also, are meals per-diem still separate from venue costs?
ben (Finance): caps are applied to total vendor invoice (includes fees). Meals are separate and follow per-diem rules unless you itemize on an event invoice. We'll update the short FAQ. :memo:

ops-bot: https://intranet.redwood/policies/hybrid-travel (policy draft - see section 2.3)

lia (HR): note on inclusivity: if your offsite includes evening social events, please add a non-alcoholic option and at least one low-sensory activity. We can add a checklist template.

raj (Eng): thanks. visa letters 1: same process as before (ops@redwood)? what's the lead time?
ryan (Recruiter): hiring-related travel still goes through recruiting-systems. For candidate travel, book via Concur and cc recruiting. For employee travel, ops@redwood as usual.

emma (People Ops): turnaround for visa letters: normally 3 business days after request + manager approval. Mark subject as "visa - expedite" if urgent.

molly (PM): desk booking q: the legacy 2-week reservation window is causing issues for product teams with rotating sprints. Any flexibility?

emma (People Ops): we're piloting a rolling 5-day window for two hubs in August (Hub-7 and Hub-3). Signups for the pilot open Monday. If you're on the pilot list, you'll get a calendar invite.

raj (Eng): any change to badge provisioning for contractors? had one stuck last week.

lia (HR): contractors with a >30 day onsite schedule auto-get badges; otherwise request via ops. For immediate needs, day pass is available via ops-desk.

ben (Finance): expense reminder: receipts for meals must show vendor name and date. Card charges without receipts will be flagged and may require employee reimbursement.

molly (PM): community question: will the company reimburse childcare for parents attending required offsites?

emma (People Ops): short answer: case-by-case. If childcare is required so the employee can attend a mandatory company event, open a PEOPLE-OPS case with estimate and we'll route to Finance + Manager for approval. We'll add an explicit example to the FAQ.

ops-bot: Heads-up: travel stipend pilot (coworking) goes live Aug 1. See intranet for signup.

raj (Eng): last quick one 1: if people extend personal travel after an offsite, is travel insurance covered?

ben (Finance): company covers standard group travel insurance for dates listed on the event booking. Personal extensions need personal insurance; exceptions possible with pre-approval.

emma (People Ops): thanks all. We'll collate answers and post a short follow-up doc in #announcements by EOD. If you need immediate exceptions DM @emma or tag @people-ops. :white_check_mark:
